_comment: #492. This template exists to make storefront_mission_tiled (#472, design #452 §3's
'tiled bulkhead storefront') reachable - it was one of the last two shipped presets no
template placed. It is the MINORITY half of the Mission: library.json's
districtTemplateWeights draws mission_victorian over it 10:1, so roughly 1 building in 11
gets a shopfront. Without weights TryMatch's tie-break is uniform and every second building
in the district would be a shop.
WHY IT IS A SEPARATE TEMPLATE rather than another placement inside mission_victorian: the
shopfront IS the ground floor (it carries its own recessed entry via
entrySide/entryWidth/entryLeaves), so at 7.36 m it cannot share floor 0 with a garage and a
door at any facade width, and the schema has no 'these placements are mutually exclusive'
field to say so inside one template. One exact owns floor 0 per template; the choice happens
one level up, at template selection. Same shape as noe_valley_victorian /
noe_valley_corner_commercial (#475).
GATED BY NEIGHBORHOOD ONLY, and it cannot be otherwise: BuildingFactsJson.building_type is
the raw OSM `building` tag and reads "yes" for 93.3% of the 11,111 buildings measured in
#472, so a compatibility.building_types list would match everything or nothing. Until #486
bakes a real commercial signal, ~1 in 11 Mission buildings - houses included - is dressed as a
shop. Do not add a building_types filter here expecting it to help; it will silently do
nothing.
Sizing is not expressible either: PlacePart applies uniform scale only and nothing carries the
real facade width into the part's `w`, so the 7.36 m shopfront is 7.36 m on a 5 m facade and
on a 25 m one alike (#487). storefront_mission_tiled is the widest shipped shopfront after
storefront_soma_loft, which makes that overhang the most visible here.
No bay and no roofPart: design #452 §3 marks the slanted bay and all three shipped cornices
exclusive to Noe Valley / Sunset/Parkside / South of Market. Windows start at floor 1 -
floor 0 is the shopfront.
NOT RENDERED. `Mission` is outside the play-area map.osm bbox, so this has never been looked
at in the Editor. What is verified is the authored data: TemplateWiringTests.
